about_subtitle: At Luar AI, we don't just build; we craft experiences. Think of us as your quirky, tech-savvy sidekicks on a mission to make awesome stuff.
about_mission_title: Our Mission: To Build with Purpose
about_mission_text: Guided by Lean Startup principles (and a lot of coffee), we focus on delivering value quickly and iteratively. We’re committed to solving real problems through technology, building with intention, curiosity, and care at every step. Your success is our success, after all!
about_vision_title: Our Vision: Bold Ideas, Powerful Solutions
about_vision_text: We aim to be the company known for turning audacious ideas into digital solutions that actually make a positive dent in the universe. Our vision is to lead with innovation and leave a lasting mark through technology that uplifts and empowers.
about_advantage_subtitle: Why are we the bee's knees? Glad you asked.
about_advantage_1_text: We create intuitive and engaging digital experiences that your users will love so much, they might just write a song about it.
about_advantage_2_text: Benefit from reduced time-to-market and minimized risk. We're faster than a cheetah on a skateboard.
about_advantage_3_text: Comprehensive digital solutions under one roof. We're like a Swiss Army knife for your digital needs, but with fewer pointy bits.
footer_text_2: Made with ♥ and a sprinkle of stardust.
services_subtitle: From MVPs that actually work to full-blown digital ecosystems, we turn your vision into code, pixels, and magic. Whether you need a turbocharged product launch or help untangling spaghetti systems — we’ve got the tools, the team, and the weird metaphors to make it happen.
services_1_text: From sleek websites to robust web applications, we create responsive, scalable solutions that engage users.
services_2_text: We design intuitive, high-performing iOS and Android apps to expand your reach and deepen engagement.
services_3_text: Automate repetitive tasks and streamline workflows with custom solutions that enhance efficiency.
services_4_text: Get expert insight to shape your digital strategy, identify opportunities, and build a roadmap for innovation.
how_we_work_subtitle: Partnering With You, Every Step of the Way
how_we_work_1_text: We start by deeply understanding your vision and goals to map out the best path forward.
how_we_work_2_text: We craft your solution with expertise, iterating based on real feedback.
how_we_work_3_text: We ensure quality and deploy for impact.
how_we_work_4_text: We're here for ongoing support and future enhancements.
services_cta_subtitle: Whether you have a clear vision or are seeking guidance, we're here to help you succeed.
contact_subtitle: We love hearing from curious minds, bold dreamers, and anyone with a project that needs just the right dose of logic and lunar magic. Whether it's an MVP, a weird question, or just a digital high-five — our inbox is always open.

portfolio_subtitle: Take a peek into the universe of things we’ve built — from pixel-perfect interfaces to clever automations and bold experiments. This is where ideas meet execution, and imagination takes center stage. Warning: may cause sudden bursts of inspiration.
portfolio_zenota_text: A visual-first note-taking app that combines a spatial canvas with structured hierarchies. Zenota features an AI assistant, "Structo," to automate note organization, making it ideal for visual thinkers who need clarity and structure.
portfolio_sanfanson_text: A language-learning game that uses interactive minigames and an AI-powered feedback system to make learning new languages engaging and effective. Features include leaderboards, progress tracking, and dynamic content generation.
portfolio_picky_text: An interactive and intelligent digital menu for restaurants. Picky allows users to filter dishes by ingredients, allergens, and dietary needs. It also features an AI-powered admin view ("Pickyto") to help restaurant owners digitalize their menus effortlessly.
